name: Rigged Climbing Loops OLD
description: Loose handholds rip away from the walls to drop unsuspecting climbers into the chasm below.
disable: DC 16 Crafting (trained) or DC 16 Thievery to anchor the climbing loops more securely

generalAbilities.name: Tear Free
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature climbs across the chasm without knowing which of the loops are rigged

Effect The loops rip free, dropping the climber 20 feet into the chasm below and dealing 10 Bludgeoning Damage damage. The falling creature can use the Grab an Edge reaction to avoid falling if it succeeds at a DC 11 Flat ; failure indicates that the edge grabbed rips away as well.
